CLOSURE_MOD_RELIC_CLOSURE_MOD_RELIC.desc: Your energy can drop as low as [blue]-{EnergyDebt}[/blue]. At turn end, gain [blue]1[/blue] Debt for each negative energy.
CLOSURE_MOD_RELIC_CLOSURE_MOD_RELIC.flav: Half business inventory, half battlefield insurance.
CLOSURE_MOD_RELIC_ANCIENT_CLOSURE_MOD_RE: Your energy can drop as low as [blue]-{EnergyDebt}[/blue]. At turn end, gain [blue]1[/blue] Debt for each negative energy, then reduce it by [blue]{DebtReduction}[/blue].
The ledger sinks a little deeper, but at least someone is erasing one line of red.
